plainTranslation: This aspect can make feelings move fast. One person's emotional reactions may trigger the other person's defensiveness, desire, impatience, or anger before either of them has time to think.
humanMoment: {{holder1}}'s emotional state triggers {{holder2}}'s defensiveness before anyone even finishes a sentence. Tiny missteps escalate into full fires in seconds.
summaryDeep: Their push keeps bruising your softer needs. You feel poked right where you're tender. They slow down, and you say the hurt directly.
tension: The problem is when the friction becomes the main way you stay connected. If things only feel alive when someone is upset, the relationship can start to confuse tension with intimacy. You poke, they react. They push, you defend. After a while, both people are tired, but neither one knows how to get close without lighting something up first.
advice: Catch the small thing while it is still small. Not every feeling needs to become a fight. This connection works better when both people learn how to pause before trying to win the moment.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
